note: The research tree screen (menu 135): a window over the whole screen with the faction header, the branch list on the left, the node grid in the middle with parent-child lines on a canvas, the node card on the right and a hint line. OZL_TreeMenu.c resolves by name: OwnerChip, OwnerName, PoolLine, BtnClose, BranchList (the stack the rows go into), TreeArea, TreeBg, TreeLines, CardName, CardDesc, CardCost, CardItems, CardTime, CardStatus, CardProgressBox, CardProgress, BtnResearch, TreeHint. Nodes are instances of oz_research_node.layout created by the script inside TreeArea at Col * 220, Row * 84 -- the inner geometry of a panel of known size, so coordinates are allowed there. Steel and cold light from the core's tokens; orange only for a node in progress.

panel.name: TreeDim
panel.note: Dims the world behind the window.

frame.name: TreeWindow
frame.note: 1720 wide leaves 100 units a side at 16:9; five node columns of 220 (a 176-unit node and a 44-unit gap for the lines) fit the 1100-unit tree area. Vertical: 860 = 34 (header) + 10 + 784 (body) + 10 + 22 (hint).

chip.name: OwnerChip
chip.note: Shown by the script, painted the faction colour the core gives.

row.name: OZL_BranchRow
row.note: One branch. The script renames the root to the branch id and reads it back on click.

panel.name: TreeArea
panel.note: The node grid host. TreeBg is the owner's background texture, swapped by the script (LoadImageFile) or hidden when the owner has none; TreeLines is the canvas the parent-child lines are drawn on.

text.name: CardCost
text.note: Two lines: point type names are long and admin-written.

panel.name: CardProgress
panel.note: The script stretches it to the elapsed fraction of a running project.

button.name: BtnResearch
button.note: Visible only when the node is available and the server said MaySpend.
